what_to_detect: A token on the battlefield whose characteristics are exactly those its creating effect defined: no mana cost, supertype, rules text or ability beyond them.
near_miss: A token carrying a characteristic its creating effect did not define.
record_fields: state.entities[]: token_script_id, name, types, colors, pt, mana_value, face_state, copy_of

what_to_detect: A token whose creating effect names no name is named its subtype(s) plus the word Token.
near_miss: A token created with a name the effect gave.
record_fields: state.entities[]: token_script_id, name, types, colors, pt, mana_value, face_state, copy_of

what_to_detect: A static or lasting effect changes a token's subtypes and the token keeps the name it was created with.
near_miss: The same effect on a card, whose name is its own.

what_to_detect: A static ability that affects permanents of a type or subtype contributes to a token as it does to a card.
near_miss: The same static ability contributing to a card and not to a token.

what_to_detect: A predefined token (Walker, Incubator, Powerstone ...) in the snapshot carries the characteristics rule 111.10 defines for its kind, which a trigger's condition then reads.
near_miss: A token of another kind whose characteristics do not meet the condition.
record_fields: state.entities[]: token_script_id, name, types, colors, pt, mana_value, face_state, copy_of

what_to_detect: A nonartifact spell candidate is not affordable because the mana a Powerstone token adds can't be spent on it.
near_miss: The same mana spent on an artifact spell: the candidate is affordable.

what_to_detect: An Incubator token carries the predefined characteristics of its two faces and, once transformed, those of a Phyrexian artifact creature.
near_miss: An Incubator token that stays on its front face.
record_fields: state.entities[]: token_script_id, name, types, colors, pt, mana_value, face_state, copy_of
the Incubator's transform activation's resolution: a face_change event, which outcome_event (event face_change, source_token_kind Incubator) reads on a resolution-kind scenario

what_to_detect: A trigger a Role token grants resolves: the acting line is from the token's script, while the source is the enchanted creature.
near_miss: The same trigger not firing for a creature outside its condition.

what_to_detect: A spell candidate is affordable by counting the mana a Heartwood token adds ({R} or {G}).
near_miss: A candidate whose colour that mana cannot pay: not affordable.

what_to_detect: A token created by name alone, the name not a predefined kind, carries the characteristics of the card of that name.
near_miss: A token created with characteristics the effect defines itself.
record_fields: state.entities[]: token_script_id, name, types, colors, pt, mana_value, face_state, copy_of
